newsitem.title: USA: Arden Q3 hurt by customer plant shutdown.
newsitem.headline: Arden Q3 hurt by customer plant shutdown.

text.p: Arden Industrial Products Inc said Monday its third quarter revenues were hurt by a temporary plant shut-down by its largest customer, but gross margins and the operating expense ratio improved compared to the second quarter.
The positive third quarter trends are continuing into the fourth quarter, the company said.
During the third quarter ended March 31, Arden posted earnings of $31,000 on sales of $21.5 million, compared with net income of $226,000 on sales of $25.2 million last year.

"Our corrective actions and new initiatives have brought down our cost structure while improving service levels to our customers, and reduced inventories by more than $3 million from second quarter levels," Arden said.

"While much more work remains to be done in correcting key process problems, we are confident that we are taking the right steps to restore Arden to an acceptable level of performance," the company said.
